verdict.rationale: Honcho is an open-source memory and state layer for AI agents. It stores messages, reasons over them in the background, and serves context, so user-defined automations that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back fall outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an automation feature that would make this axis apply; its background reasoning (deriver/Dreamer) is internal memory processing, not user-authored automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
